title: 第十六章　理由
content_zh:
人活着总需要理由，不去想并不代表不需要。

    “你是谁？”无尽的深渊中，艾妮尔站在一眼望不到边的水面上，水面竟然一点涟漪也没有，如同一面无暇的镜子，可是心却不静，因为它在说话，以一种寻问的口气。

    “你为什么活着？”

    “你有亲人吗？”

    “你活着有什么意义？”

    “你……”

    “够了！”艾妮尔的脸色在一次次的承受下逐渐扭曲，十指成拳，最后彻底的暴发，“不要再说了。”

    “你是谁？”

    “你为什么活着？”

    ……

    结果那些声音不但没有消失，而反更大声，更快速的回响着，一次次，一倍倍的增加，不断的刺激刺激着艾妮尔的双耳，以及灵魂。

    “我是艾妮尔！我是贵族。”艾妮尔不断回答着，可是除了这两个，其实的答案她根本无法找到，比如说，她为什么活着，她活着又有什么意义？

    她叫艾妮尔，可是除了这个名字，完全没有过去，所以大脑中那成片的空白，或者说白茫茫中根本无法找到任何的理由，至于未来，哼！连过去都没有的未来，真的存在吗？

    “我……”艾妮尔喊累了，突然停了下来，捂着自己的耳朵，静静的站着，因为这个时候心又在说话了，而且不同于先前。

    “其实你什么也不是！”

    “你没有亲人，也没有朋友。”

    “你根本就不应该存在！”

    “你最好消失。”

    “你……”

    “我……”听到数遍的回答之后，艾妮尔倒是松开了捂着双耳的手，“我真的什么都不是吗？如果是，那为什么我会存在，为什么会在这里？为什么……”
content_en:
People always need a reason to live. Just because you don't think about it doesn't mean you don't need it.

    "Who are you?" In the endless abyss, Enel stood on the water that could not be seen to the edge. The water surface had no ripples at all, like a flawless mirror, but her heart was not calm, because it was speaking in a questioning tone.

    "Why are you alive?"

    "Do you have any relatives?"

    "What's the point of living for you?"

    "You..."

    "That's enough!" Enel's face gradually distorted under the repeated exposure, her fingers clenched into fists, and finally she completely exploded, "Stop talking anymore."

    "Who are you?"

    "Why are you alive?"

    …

    As a result, those sounds not only did not disappear, but echoed louder and faster, doubling again and again, constantly stimulating Enel's ears and soul.

    "I am Enel! I am a noble." Enel kept answering, but apart from these two, she could not find the actual answer at all. For example, why is she alive, and what is the meaning of her life?

    Her name is Enel, but apart from this name, she has no past at all, so there is a blank in her brain, or there is no reason to be found in the vast whiteness. As for the future, hum! Does a future that doesn’t even have a past really exist?

    "I..." Enel was tired of shouting, and suddenly stopped, covering her ears, and stood quietly, because at this time, her heart was talking again, and it was different from before.

    "Actually, you are nothing!"

    "You have no relatives or friends."

    "You shouldn't even exist!"

    "You'd better disappear."

    "You..."

    "I..." After hearing the answer several times, Enel released her hands covering her ears, "Am I really nothing? If so, then why do I exist, why am I here? Why..."
